Marta (eng-ml): hey team — quick async sweep before tomorrow's catalog sync. two new open models (ozark-3b-lite, mariner-2.7b) landed in staging. need short status: owners, license ok, perf profile, and canary window. to be clear: final catalog push won't happen without these.
Kai (eng-platform): ozark-3b-lite: infra owner = me, can do canary on prod-dedicated slot, ETA tomorrow morning. need perf profile from ML team though. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Arjun (product): mariner-2.7b: product owner = arjun. canary goal: 1k qps ramp, watch p95 and cost. can someone confirm token-cost estimate?
Sophia (legal): quick heads up — mariner's license has a CLA requirement in the repo. I asked upstream for a CLA copy, awaiting reply. until we get that, mark mariner as "license pending".
Marta (eng-ml): Catalog fields we need filled (minimal): owners, license_status, perf_profile (p50/p95 tokens/ms), expected_token_cost_per_1k, rollout_window (start/end). I'll paste a tiny example card below:
```
model_card:
  owners: ["Arjun (product)"]
  license_status: "pending"
  perf_profile: "p50=18ms p95=52ms (seq=512)"
  token_cost_per_1k: "$1.12"
  rollout_window: "2023-10-12T09:00Z/2023-10-12T12:00Z"
```
Liam (eng-sre): IaC note: for ozark canary we should pin kernel+quantization profile to avoid perf drift. I'll open a tiny PR to platform infra with the pinned config.
CatalogBot: Added checklist item #3421 for ozark-3b-lite: "perf profile missing".
Kai (eng-platform): Marta can you own the perf_profile collection for ozark? I can run perf harness but need target sequences and prompt shapes.
Marta (eng-ml): I can run the harness. send me 5 representative prompt templates and seq targets. Arjun — can you drop 2 product prompts for mariner (chat + summarization)?
Arjun (product): dropping here: 1) "Summarize the following meeting notes in 3 bullets" 2) "Rewrite this error message to be user friendly and include suggestions". seq targets: 128, 512.
Sophia (legal): For mariner CLA — if upstream doesn't respond in 48h we might need to exclude from initial catalog and relist in next batch. pinging the open-source maintainer cc @legal. :mag:
Marta (eng-ml): timeline check: if infra + perf profiles + license cleared by EOD tomorrow, we can rollout a limited canary Friday AM. otherwise postpone. who will be oncall for the canary?
Liam (eng-sre): I'll be oncall for Friday AM window. will watch p95, memory jitter, and fallback triggers.
Kai (eng-platform): I'll coordinate the canary job and rollback policy. suggest measuring p95 and tokens/sec delta vs baseline and auto-fallback to small-variant on 3% error or 20% latency regression.
Marta (eng-ml): small todo list: - Kai: infra canary job (confirm by EOD) - Liam: oncall for canary (confirmed) - Arjun: product prompts (done) - Sophia: license follow-up (in flight) - Marta: perf runs + model cards (I'll post results) - CatalogBot: mark readiness flag once all fields present
Arjun (product): quick question — do we need a QA review for behavior regressions or just perf/license?
Marta (eng-ml): both. add a short eval set (5 prompts) for regression checks. if model changes output significantly vs baseline we block.
Sophia (legal): noted. I'll approve license_status "cleared" only after CLA or compatible license proof in repo.
CatalogBot: Checklist updated: ozark-3b-lite -> perf data attached? false; mariner-2.7b -> license_status: pending.
Kai (eng-platform): ping @Marta if you want me to attach harness scripts to your run. I'll also drop the canary playbook link in the thread.
Marta (eng-ml): thanks. I'll run perf tonight and post p50/p95 + token estimates. if anyone has objections to Friday limited canary, speak now. :eyes:
Arjun (product): good to me. :+1:
Liam (eng-sre): good to me.
Sophia (legal): fine as long as license gate is enforced.
Marta (eng-ml): awesome — will post updates here when perf runs complete. tagging this thread as the single source for owner/dep status. cheers.
